title: TX queue: eliminate FIFO half-range sequence ambiguity
description: Security/robustness review found that uint32_t enqueue_order plus signed half-range comparison can reverse FIFO/preemption ordering when one long-lived low-priority entry remains queued while at least 2^31 higher-priority enqueue/pop operations advance the sequence. Explicit deadlines may remain live for INT32_MAX ms, so the current adjacency-only wrap test does not prove the API invariant. Use an ordering representation or renormalization that cannot become ambiguous for live entries and add a half-range-gap regression test.
acceptance_criteria: FIFO and oldest-lowest preemption remain correct across uint32 half-range/full-wrap gaps without relying on packet enqueue rates; regression tests exercise a synthetic gap >=2^31; sanitizer-backed host tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
